method: DPR1 native own-size DOM fields, 30 warmup +80 completed samples. Three captures per scenario. Active fixed-step compute and render; uncontrolled load. Particle count 1024 and maximum 2048, single instance per scenario. CPU, GPU timestamps and completed-work wall latency reported separately.
